armor.description: Whatever the station had, organised the way a band organises itself. (Independent tradition, irregular mix)
armor.name: Watchman's Kit

armor.description: Security contracts, run as a line section because that is the drill they were taught. (Sindrian Diktat tradition, line hold mix)
armor.name: Diktat State Security Issue

armor.description: Auxiliary sections keep the Hegemony's shape on a fraction of its issue. (Hegemony tradition, line hold mix)
armor.name: Hegemony Auxiliary Schedule

armor.description: A coalition screen that expects to move and to be seen doing it. (Persean tradition, reconnaissance mix)
armor.name: League Mobile Guard Standard

armor.description: Parish wardens hold a place; they do not go out looking for one. (Luddic Church tradition, line hold mix)
armor.name: Church Parish Warden Kit

armor.description: A raiding band: everybody fights, two carry the heavy thing, nobody scouts for long. (Pirates tradition, irregular mix)
armor.name: Blackforge Raider Lot

armor.description: Corporate operators, weighted toward the half of the section that is paid to see. (Tritachyon tradition, reconnaissance mix)
armor.name: Tri-Tachyon Recon Package

armor.description: The standard section, and what every other composition is measured against. (Hegemony tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Hegemony Line Schedule

armor.description: Interchangeable by design, so a member world can replace any billet in it. (Persean tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: League Coalition Line Standard

armor.description: A response section: quick, well-sighted, and unwilling to stand and trade. (Tritachyon tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Tri-Tachyon Response Package

armor.description: Commissary-approved kit, and a section that intends to still be there afterwards. (Luddic Church tradition, line hold mix)
armor.name: Church Commissary Line Kit

armor.description: A conspicuous advance, which is most of the point of it. (Sindrian Diktat tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Diktat Regular Line Issue

armor.description: Veterans of a trade that rewards volume and speed over anything else. (Pirates tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Blackforge Veteran Lot

armor.description: Militia plate and two cargo frames: cheap, square-shouldered and in the field this week. (Independent tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Freeport Militia Assault Kit

armor.description: Four recovered power suits, two ARM-TACH-3-PWR (QS) breachers and two ARM-HEG-3-PWR (QS) support gunners, among a scout and seven riflemen in militia armor. The whole section comes with the card; the suits are a third of the squad. (Independent tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Salvage-assisted Section

armor.description: Two ARM-TACH-3-PWR (QS) powered breachers in the assault seats, a scout, two support gunners in ARM-TACH-3-SUPP and seven riflemen in combat armor. A first, light taste of powered armor: ten of twelve marines stay in ordinary kit. (Tritachyon tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Tri-Tachyon Specter Section

armor.description: Two rebuilt ARM-PIR-3-PWR frames in the assault seats, a scout, two support gunners in packframes and seven raiders in outlaw plate. Ten of twelve marines stay in ordinary kit; the frames go through the hatch first. (Pirates tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Boarding Jack Section

armor.description: Two ARM-HEG-3-PWR (QS) powered support suits, with an ARM-HEG-3-RCN scout and ten riflemen in ARM-HEG-3-LN. The rest of the section stays in ordinary Hegemony kit. (Hegemony tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Hegemony Arbalest Section

armor.description: Two ARM-HEG-4-PWR (MSL) powered support suits, with an ARM-HEG-3-RCN scout and riflemen in ARM-HEG-3-LN. Issued only under a Hegemony military warrant. (Hegemony tradition, balanced mix)
armor.name: Hegemony Auxiliary Section

armor.description: A deliberate breach: two teams through the door and one making the hole bigger. (Hegemony tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: Hegemony XIV Shock Schedule

armor.description: The same breach, bought from a company that sells prediction rather than plate. (Tritachyon tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: Tri-Tachyon Specter Package

armor.description: Coalition breach formations, built so the marine beside you need not be from your navy. (Persean tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: League Bulwark Breach Standard

armor.description: A Knight crosses the room in front of somebody else, and the section is arranged around that. (Knights Of Ludd tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: Knights' Armoury Heavy Issue

armor.description: Prestige issue: allotted by political favour, and fielded where the regime wants it seen. (Lions Guard tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: Lion's Guard Mantle Issue

armor.description: Industrial rigs pointed at a door by people with no formal doctrine at all. (Pirates tradition, breach mix)
armor.name: Foundry-Breaker Rig Lot

weapon.description: Twelve basic field rifles. Specialist weapons must be learned before fitting.
weapon.name: Dockside Issue

weapon.description: Three Milspec automatics anchor nine riflemen (seeded by hand; built in code).
weapon.name: Steady Line

weapon.description: Six Milspec pulse rifles on the leaders and second seats (seeded by hand; built in code).
weapon.name: Forward Screen

weapon.description: Recovered and improvised close-assault weapons built around breach tools.
weapon.name: Path Cell Assault Cache

weapon.description: Mixed coalition issue with standardized leaders, support fire, and smoke cover.
weapon.name: League Line Fire-Team Standard

weapon.description: High-tech line weapons and unmarked breaching carbines for a short, decisive entry.
weapon.name: Blacksite Breach Package

weapon.description: Rugged automatics and rail marksmen backed by scarce heavy armory issue.
weapon.name: Hegemony Fire Support Schedule

weapon.description: Service rifles, four rocket tubes for the guns and grenades for the trench behind them.
weapon.name: Trench-Clearing Issue

weapon.description: Service rifles that dig in and hold: three sappers with satchel charges to clear the post and smoke to cover them while they work.
weapon.name: Checkpoint Issue

weapon.description: A screen that keeps rockets off the trucks: a rocket tube in every team and one DEP-PD-GUN to stand over the column.
weapon.name: Convoy Escort Issue

weapon.description: Hegemony issue for living under mortar fire: two MBL-PD-MLS packs to stop the rounds and an anti-materiel rifle for the tube.
weapon.name: Counter-Battery Issue

weapon.description: Holding a construction site out of the Shepherd yard stores: three sappers with satchel charges and two DEP-PD-GUNs over the plots.
weapon.name: Builder's Guard
